candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: Given valid before/input lengths, up=area_length-writeidx, down=actual-up, 0<=down<=writeidx, and after=input[up:actual]++before[down:writeidx]++input[0:up], prove CircularAreaRingUpdate before input after area_length writeidx actual.

Given 0<=writeidx, writeidx+actual<=area_length, valid lengths, and after=before[0:writeidx]++input[0:actual]++before[writeidx+actual:area_length], prove CircularAreaRingUpdate before input after area_length writeidx actual.
For up=area_length-writeidx and down=actual-up with 0<area_length, writeidx<area_length, up<=actual<=area_length, prove Z.rem (writeidx+actual) area_length = down.
